issues.title: Ingest Independence County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $38,170,066 across 55 funds. The largest: County Road Fund ($9,884,077), County General Fund ($8,935,331), Integrated Solid Waste System Fund ($3,652,400). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.

issues.title: Reconcile County Sheriff (County General Fund)
issues.detail: The ordinance appropriates $2,325,096.00; the categories on the 2026 budget worksheet add to $2,325,081.00. Ask the county treasurer or clerk which figure is right, and how the adopted amount splits.
